prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Your pet will spawn directly on your desktop screen once generation is complete."]
1: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Log in with your primary account to keep and sync your saved desktop pets.", "Choose primary login method to restore existing pets."]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet on the desktop to open settings, hide, or talk to it anytime.", "Right-click for options menu, drag to move around desktop screen"]
3: ["Choose Preset Companion for instant setup, or Custom Pet to upload your own photo."]
4: ["Upload Clear Photos for Best Results", "Use well-lit photos with clear facial features for proper pet generation.", "Avoid dark or blurry photos for best results."]
5: ["Welcome to Your Desktop! Here is Your Starter Item", "Your pet is now active on your screen with a complimentary starter item unlocked.", "Starter Item Unlocked!"]
6: ["Save Your Pet Progress", "Sign in to attach your desktop pet to your account.", "Continue & Save Pet"]
7: ["Click any companion card to select your pet."]
8: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Quick Adopt or Custom Pet Creation"]
9: ["You can minimize this window. We will notify you when your pet is ready!"]
